title: Ep 001 – Dennis Yu
guest_bio: Digital marketing pioneer, early Yahoo search/analytics leader, and one of the most-featured guests in Conquer Local history. Known for the 'dollar-a-day' strategy, Facebook/TikTok ad playbooks, and building AI-agent-driven teams.
summary: Dennis Yu joins George Leith for the Evolved Pros debut: evolving with AI, taking 'the network view,' hiring by proof, agents as multipliers, and why your value isn't your skill set.

chapters.title: The debut — why Dennis Yu is guest #1
Math Olympiad to Yahoo: the data-access edge
Taking 'the network view' to stay ahead

When money doesn't matter: you're not your skill

pull_quotes.speaker: Dennis Yu
pull_quotes.text: My advantage my entire career has always been: do I have more and better data access?

pull_quotes.speaker: Dennis Yu
pull_quotes.text: If you understand what the market maker, the network, is looking to do, that gives you a better view.

pull_quotes.speaker: Dennis Yu
pull_quotes.text: Google had all that AI stuff years ago. They intentionally sat on it because it affected their ability to monetize.

pull_quotes.speaker: Dennis Yu
pull_quotes.text: The things AI's not gonna touch is physical AI right now — roofers and plumbers.

pull_quotes.speaker: George Leith
pull_quotes.text: The line that makes the hair on the back of my neck stand up is, 'That's not the way we've always done it.'

pull_quotes.speaker: Dennis Yu
pull_quotes.text: No amount of logic, no amount of persuasion, no amount of reports can overcome when the CEO says it.

pull_quotes.speaker: Dennis Yu
pull_quotes.text: One or two key decisions or realizations is all it takes to make a whole week of productivity.

pull_quotes.speaker: Dennis Yu
pull_quotes.text: I can use agents as a multiplier — get 10 times more out of an A player.

pull_quotes.speaker: Dennis Yu
pull_quotes.text: Here's three balls. Juggle them for me. Right now. Show me.

pull_quotes.speaker: Dennis Yu
pull_quotes.text: If your entire value is tied up in you as a worker, you have a bigger issue to deal with.

pull_quotes.speaker: Dennis Yu
pull_quotes.text: Your value should come from you as a person, your relationships, not the fact that you have a particular skill.

pull_quotes.speaker: Dennis Yu
pull_quotes.text: Every day is Christmas to me.
